summary: Composes a HUD warning-icon string into an 8-byte local buffer by querying three warning conditions in order: a general warning indicator (sub_49B9A0, appends icon byte -126), a fuel/low-fuel warning (FuelWeightComputation, appends 'D' = 68), and a two-state indicator (sub_49BA30, appends -116 for state 1 or -115 for state 2). If any warning is active (v2 > 0) the buffer is null-terminated and rendered with UITextRenderWithScale at x = a1 + 275, y = a2; otherwise the function returns the last state code from sub_49BA30.

local_names.a1: base x coordinate for the warning text position (render x = a1 + 275)
local_names.a2: y coordinate for the warning text position
local_names.v2: write index into the warning icon buffer
local_names.result: state indicator code returned by sub_49BA30
local_names.v4: composed warning icon byte buffer (up to 8 bytes)

operations.description: v2 = 0: initialize the warning-buffer write index
Calls sub_49B9A0 to query the general warning indicator state
If sub_49B9A0 returned nonzero, the general warning indicator is active
v4[0] = -126 (general warning icon byte) and v2 = 1 when the general warning is active
Calls FuelWeightComputation to query the fuel/low-fuel warning state
If FuelWeightComputation returned nonzero, the fuel warning is active
v4[v2++] = 68 ('D' fuel icon byte), advancing the write index
Calls sub_49BA30 to query the state indicator code, storing it into result
If result == 1, state indicator 1 is active
Re-calls sub_49BA30 in the else path to re-query the state indicator code
In the else path, if result != 2 jump to the render check (no state icon appended)
++v2: advance the write index after the state-icon block
If v2 > 0, at least one warning icon is present in the buffer
v4[v2] = 0: null-terminate the composed warning string
Renders the composed warning string with UITextRenderWithScale at x = a1 + 275, y = a2, color 0xFFFFFF, flags 1/3 and scale 2.0/2.0
Returns the UITextRenderWithScale result when warnings were rendered
Returns result (the last sub_49BA30 value) when v2 <= 0, i.e. no warning is active
